content.text: Yes, I think that's the best place to play volleyball.
content.trans: 是的，我认为这是最好的地方来打排球。

content.text: You know, we even have beach volleyball up in freezing cold Canada.
content.trans: 我知道，我们甚至在寒冷的加拿大也有沙滩排球。

content.text: And do you have sand?
content.trans: 您有沙子吗？

content.text: Occasionally.
content.trans: 偶尔。

content.text: All right, so volleyball is a great sport,
content.trans: 好的，所以排球是一项很好的运动，

content.text: but now we want to know what sport you want to learn about.
content.trans: 但是现在我们想要知道你想学习哪个运动。

content.text: We've covered soccer, we've covered basketball, we've covered volleyball.
content.trans: 我们已经谈到了足球、篮球和排球。

content.text: So tell us what other sports you would like to learn vocabulary and phrases on.
content.trans: 所以，告诉我你希望学习更多的什么体育项目和词汇。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 正确。

content.text: You can tell us this and many more things at EnglishPod.com, our website.
content.trans: 您可以在这里告诉我们这些和更多的事情，如英语播客网站。

content.text: So check it out.
content.trans: 所以，请看看它。

content.text: Right.
content.trans: 右。

content.text: Leave your questions and comments, and we'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 离开你的问题和评论，我们见你们！

content.text: Thanks for downloading, and until next time, goodbye.
content.trans: 非常感谢您下载，下一次再见。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 再见。
